entries.evidence: Protective restatement, appended BEFORE the INC-00311 narrowing below so that no answer for INC-00497 moves. Once INC-00311 carries a successor-identified record, a last-record-wins walk from INC-00497 would stop at INC-14726, an incident INC-00497 never named (it named Saint Paisios in v2.0.0-v2.1.0 and the Greek tax system in v2.2.0-v2.8.0; both scoped records stay in force). It is the last record for INC-00497, unscoped, so validate.py's rule (a) holds. Measured before writing: without this record resolve_id('INC-00497') moves from None to INC-14726 and resolve_id_group('INC-00497') from 12 IDs to 1.
